Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

MMMU-Pro: A More Robust Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding Benchmark (2409.02813v1) · paper method: GPT-4o (0513) scores 51.9 overall, averaging 54.0 in ten-option standard form and 49.7 in vision form.

cohort6.claim.mmmupro.gpt4o-result

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • Paired underlying questions; the authors report the higher result from Direct and CoT prompts, so this is not a single fixed-prompt evaluation.
